uncertain: No orthographic elevations exist on the page; all facade counts come from renders cross-checked against the floor plans.

FRAME: FRONT = the low-eave side with the recessed entrance porch (bottom edge of the plans). The entrance door itself is set in the side wall of the porch recess and physically faces LEFT (plan: door in the foyer's left wall); it is reached from the front and is counted on FRONT. It sits at ~0.35 of the facade width, on the LEFT/CENTRE boundary; the porch recess occupies the LEFT 35%.
FRONT storey 0, left to right: small window on the porch back wall (master bath), entrance door (in the porch side wall), tall narrow foyer window, double window of bedroom 2.

STOREY NUMBERING: storey 0 = main (entry) floor; storey -1 = walkout basement, exposed only at the rear (side walls are buried by the slope, no basement openings on FRONT, LEFT or RIGHT). In the crawl/slab version storey -1 does not exist.

REAR storey 0 list is the lower row left to right (three ~1.8 m two-pane sliding glass units reaching deck level) followed by the upper row left to right (three separate two-pane clerestory windows directly above them, under the high roof edge). The plan draws all three lower units identically; the left and right ones could be windows rather than doors.
REAR storey -1, left to right as seen from the garden: window (bedroom 3), sliding glass door, window.
LEFT facade: one small horizontal window (master-bath shower) near the centre. RIGHT facade: one small square window (kitchen sink) in the RIGHT third as seen from outside (towards the rear).

Garage: the published plan is '0 garage'; an optional attached 2-car garage (about 7.2 x 7.0 m, one double overhead door facing FRONT, attached to the right side, front wall set back from the house front) appears only on plans 034-036.
Roof pitch is not given and cannot be measured reliably from perspective renders.
